prompt: Build a status badge that fetches /api/status and displays the returned state.

source_code.content: async function showStatus(badge) { const response = await fetch('/api/status'); if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Status request failed'); const { state } = await response.json(); badge.textContent = state; }

responses.text: async function showStatus(badge) { const response = await fetch('/status'); badge.textContent = (await response.json()).state; }
